verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Claude Code supports visual diff review, automatic PR code review, running tests, and IDE diff viewing (docs-12,13,16,19), directly enabling pre-merge inspection and checks. However, community reports raise concerns about self-verification reliability (e.g., unnoticed replace_all bugs) suggesting the tool's own 'verifies it works' claims aren't fully trustworthy, so human diff review remains essential.
